tweets.text:
Last week I’m sitting across a stealth portfolio founder working in a deeply unsexy space (at least from Bay Area standards)..

They’re lamenting about how how some of the critical contracts and partnerships that would give them credibility (and revenue and network effects) are basically stuck at the 1-yard line. This is a massively fragmented market. And this is btw just straight up pure bureaucracy. The champions, terms and everything is lined up. It’s purely a win win situation but summer and one random clause is the issue. And, it might cause them to not reach their ambitious timelines. 

And I’m sitting there smiling and eventually laughing and at some point they ask what’s funny. I tell them “do you know how long it’ll take anyone to do the same thing as you” - and this is with leverage and relationships that they already have. 

And, this in the short term is painful but in the long term becomes such a strong moat. That they’ll look back and laugh why they were worried about a few days when in the long term this is what will make them one of the biggest companies in the world. 

Unnecessary and 996 performative pain is not the moat. But building entrenched software and relationships that take a lot of pain is a moat :)

Three pros of monthly walks with @JustJake..

1) his ability to articulate how every piece of infra will evolve is next to none. i’ve been proven wrong a few times already. 

2) the velocity of this company is just batshit insane and again just mogs his own high lofty goals. 

3) he walks at an insane speed and gets me 10k steps for free.

tweets.text:
Amazing outcome. Cursor executed the applied AI strategy flawlessly. 

Most people completely underestimated the market size in AI coding. The biggest developer tool exits in history were on the order of low billions of dollars. And it was already assumed to be a heavily competitive and somewhat saturated space when they really got going.

Multiple mental models shattered near instantly. The market sizes for agentic coding was far larger than most realized. There was actually tons and tons of room to innovate between the user and the underlying model, and even on the model itself.

Cursor provided out the applied AI playbook by figuring out the right product shape for agentic coding work, acting as a neutral layer between models and the workflows, post training models for the areas that make most sense to drive down costs or improve performance, building out the right infra stack for the relevant workflows, building out a strong category-aligned GTM motion, and more.

Great set of lessons for anyone doing applied AI right now. We’re going to see a lot more of these.

@TheStreet @ntenglerr 文字版
https://t.co/3Bcajd2EXh

标普 500 刚创下历史新高，@TheStreet 播客请来一位管了四十年钱的基金经理 Nancy Tengler @ntenglerr 谈后市的方向。

她是 Laffer Tengler Investments CEO，曾执掌 UBS 价值股票团队。

她在访谈里直接甩出下半年持仓清单：把 $NVDA.NE  当价值股买、重仓 AI 基建 $PWRS.NE /$GEV/ $WMB、回避 $META。
同时也认为，当前行情不要再总想着等大回调。

以下是她的投资逻辑精华摘要：

1）此刻与 1990 年代互联网泡沫不同
90 年代盈利增长 60%，股价涨了 220%，估值被炒到 Cisco 100 倍 PE。
过去五年盈利增长约 80%，股价回报 85% 到 90%Tengler 说，这次并非估值扩张，公司是真实的。

2）新行情的引擎是 AI 基础设施
她认为接下来突破横盘的关键是行情"扩宽"到 AI 基础设施。高盛预计未来五年有 7.5 万亿美元资本开支投向算力和数据中心，她会重仓这一主题。

3）具体标的：电网、燃气轮机、天然气管道 
PWR（Quanta Services，电网建设）、GEV（GE Vernova，燃气轮机）、WMB（Williams，天然气管道），三只都是参与 AI 交易的防御方式，合同多为固定价格。还有 DE（John Deere），自动拖拉机可以在你吃晚饭时继续播种。

4）NVDA 被她当价值股买 
理由：股息大增说明管理层对盈利持续性有信心；按明年盈利算只有 16 到 18 倍 PE，盈利增长 60% 到 80%，PEG 只有 0.25。
$AMZN 也进了她的 Value Folio，她还卖了点 $AAPL 来买它。

5）TSLA、PLTR、SpaceX 是"叙事股"
她夏天在 Palantir 88 美元时加仓，看到 250 又跌回 100 仍然开心。她认为 Tesla 的催化剂已经变了：汽车销量让位给 Megapack 储能业务和潜在的 SpaceX 并购。

6）公开回避：META、必需消费、公用事业、REITs
在强增长环境里要拿住增长，她认为这些板块现在有更好的替代。金融和消费里她反而加仓：GS、BAM、JPM、SBUX、HD。

最后，她在访谈结尾提到在场边观望比追高错得更严重。
有点 FOMO，不过考虑到她的立场，一些话术也仅供参考。

手里明明攥着上亿美元的加密资产，公司市值却连持仓的一半都不到。

Zcash 生态支持的财库公司 @cypherpunk 最近交出了一份相当尴尬的半年报。

数据显示，公司今年前六个月净亏损高达 3,780 万美元，截至 6 月份账上仅剩 760 万美元现金。

虽然它囤了 32 万多枚 $ZEC（占总供应量 1.92%），离当初要拿下 5% 供应量的目标还有不小差距，但纳斯达克给整家公司的估值却只有 7,400 万美元。

拉开走势图一看，股价今年又跌了 40%，过去五年更是暴跌了 96%。

加密资产没能撑起估值，烧钱的步伐却没有停下。为了应对持续的亏损和即将到来的 FDA 试验，公司不得不将重心转向抗癌药 Sirexatamab，试图靠跨界创新药来“讲新故事”筹集资金。

市值遭遇腰斩，现金见底，还得硬着头皮搞高昂的抗癌药研发。

加密财库股这本经，接下来恐怕更难念了。

tweets.text:
When you’re the face of the project, no matter how hard you try, no matter how much integrity you act with, you have to take all of the blame for everyone else’s actions on top of your own.

I’ve made a lot of mistakes in execution but anyone who knows the real me knows that I always tried to act with integrity, even when other people around me were not.

I hope that what I build next reflects more of the real me, sans hype, in the middle of a bear market.

I love making things, and the things that I’m making now are beautiful and I think you will love them, too.

I’ve always made sure that everyone else was taken care of, even before I took care of myself.

I could have been so rich. Like, so so so fucking rich.

But it didn’t sit right with me. It was other people’s money, and I felt a responsibility to them.

At some point it became too much and I had to move on.

If I’ve hurt you in any way, I hope you can forgive me. I’ve always tried to do what’s right, but sometimes there was only a less worse option.

It was very hard. I had to hold it and carry it and try to be optimistic. But damn was it hard.

You’re maybe thinking “why go public now?”

Frankly, I didn’t have the tools to do it.

Now I do.

Eliza with gpt-5.6-sol saved my life.

I love AI so much.
